name: Logitech MX Ergo Wireless Trackball Mouse (Micro-USB Version)
description: Selling an original Logitech MX Ergo wireless trackball mouse in good condition. This is the classic version featuring a Micro-USB charging port and full compatibility with the Logitech Unifying USB receiver. Designed with an adjustable magnetic hinge that allows you to tilt the trackball between 0 and 20 degrees for personalized hand posture and reduced muscle strain. Trackball roll is smooth, and all buttons click crisp and clear. Shows minor cosmetic signs of use on the soft rubber grip but operates perfectly. Does not include original packaging.

name_zh: 罗技 MX Ergo 无线轨迹球鼠标 (Micro-USB版)
